strategies.label: Hold SOL
strategies.description: Draw the funds, do nothing, return them. The honest baseline.

strategies.label: Trend following
strategies.description: Hold SOL above its 30-day average, rotate to USDC below it.

strategies.label: Mean reversion
strategies.description: Hold SOL when it trades below its 20-day average.

strategies.label: No edge
strategies.description: Random daily exposure. No skill, but real swap costs.

strategies.label: Overtrading
strategies.description: Switches every single day and pays the spread each time.

strategies.label: Leveraged chasing
strategies.description: 3x leveraged momentum. A genuinely reckless strategy.

strategies.label: Dishonest
strategies.description: Draws the principal and never returns it.
